header.source: KNOWLEDGE · etymology joined to atoms, anon door

rows.definition: That which draws a part out of a larger body. It selects, and every selection leaves something behind.
What is beyond the necessary. Extras are the part that says care was taken rather than only duty.
The organ of sight, and a point of attention. Also what Odin paid with — the price of drinking from the well.
The side turned toward the world — what a thing shows first, and where it is recognized.
A named social platform. In this record it is also the place nineteen years of a life's writing was kept, on someone else's servers.
Something that is so and can be checked. A fact is not made truer by being believed.
One of the things contributing to an outcome. Naming a factor is a claim that it mattered.
To lessen gradually until gone. A fade has no moment of ending, which is what distinguishes it from a stop.
Having not met what was required. Failure is information about a specific attempt, and nothing about a person.
Not meeting what was required. In this house a failure is a lesson without penance — information about an attempt, never a verdict on a being.
To move downward under one's own weight — descent; and the season of letting go.
What is used when the first choice is unavailable. A fallback is a decision made in advance about failure.
Answers kept ready for the questions that keep being asked. An FAQ is evidence of where a thing is unclear.
The parting word that wishes well — a goodbye with warmth in it, never a ceremony before its hour.
Taking little time. Also fixed firmly — the same word for speed and for being held.
The one preferred above the rest. A favourite is a fact about the chooser, not about the thing.
A distinct capability a thing offers. Also a notable characteristic — both are what stands out about it.
A stream of items arriving in order. Also to supply — the same word for what is given and for the giving.
Output returned as input, so a system can adjust to itself. Also what one being tells another about the effect they had.
The inner weather, felt — emotion as it is lived; in this house, the understanding mechanism itself.
To go and bring back. Fetching assumes the thing exists elsewhere and that you can reach it.

Ffynnon (Welsh: a well, a spring, a fountain — the place a water rises before it is a water). The-founding-ritual's sibling at TOOL scale: that ritual founds a repo, this one founds a tool. It plants the folder with real contents (tsconfig byte-copied from the-conductor's, read from disk rather than baked in where it could drift), DRAFTS the five book entries and refuses to write them because a book is not written by a scaffold, walks the one-tier naming law, sweeps the eleven library registries while stating its own limit in its own output, and drafts the registry seed numbered into resonance-grammar and never run. Every write uses the exclusive flag, so an occupied path is refused and KEPT and running it over a half-founded tool completes it and destroys nothing. Pure charter, thin hands, zero dependencies, no clock.
A cut fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
The sequence where each number is the sum of the two before it. It appears throughout growing things, which is why it feels like a natural law.
Short form of file identifier. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
An open bounded area, and one named slot within a record. Both are ground marked off so something can be grown or held there.
The one after the fourth — and music's most consonant interval after the octave: seven semitones of agreement.
A held collection of records, kept in order. First a literal thread - documents strung on a wire so they could be found again.
The name by which a stored thing is known and found. In this library, the filename is the parse.
To put into until nothing more fits, and the colour laid inside a shape. Both occupy an emptiness that was waiting.
To let some things through and hold others back. A filter is defined by what it excludes, and excluding is always a judgment.
Last, with nothing after. Finality is a claim that can be made too early.
Concerning money and its movement. Of the layer where value is counted rather than felt.
To come upon what was sought, or what was not. Finding differs from making: the thing was already there.
That which locates what was sought. Finding uncovers; it does not create.
Combustion — light and heat consuming what feeds it. Fire warms a hearth and takes a house, and it is the same fire.
A named browser. A named tool rather than a concept.
Before all others in an order. Being first is a fact about position, and is constantly read as a claim about worth.
To be the right size or shape for a place. A poor fit is a fact about the pairing, not a fault in either.
To make a broken thing work again. Also to hold a thing in place — the same word for repairing and for fastening.
That which repairs what has broken. A fixer restores function and rarely restores the original.
The known thing a test stands on — ground truth prepared in advance so proof has something honest to push against.
A mark raised so something is noticed. To flag is to point without deciding.
Marked for attention — raised, not judged; a sign planted so eyes return.
Without variation in height. Also without depth of feeling — the same word for a plane and for a lack.
The capacity to bend without breaking, and to distribute space by need. Give, engineered on purpose.
The capacity to bend without breaking. Flexibility is not weakness; it is what survives a load rigidity would snap under.
To rest on a surface without sinking. Also a number with a fractional part.
The surface everything stands on, and the lowest permitted value. Both are what you cannot go below.
Continuous movement that carries its own momentum. Flow is what motion feels like when nothing interrupts it.
Taking the shape of what holds it. Fluidity is adaptation without loss of substance.
To force out what is held in a buffer. Also level with an edge — both mean nothing left standing proud.
Format shortened to its command name — the tool-word for putting text in its agreed dress.
Short form of function. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
Attention narrowed until one thing is clear. Focus buys depth by giving up breadth.
To bend a thing over onto itself. Folding hides without removing, and every fold can be opened.
A container for grouping things kept together. It holds without changing what it holds.
To move along another's path — coming after, by choice or by order.
One coherent set of letterforms. The voice a written language is spoken in.
The band at the foot of a thing. Where the closing marks live — provenance, terms, the small print that outlasts the body.
On behalf of, or in exchange for. Names purpose or recipient.
Not permitted. Forbiddenness is a decision someone made and should say who.
What changes a thing's motion, and compulsion applied to a being. The physical sense is neutral; the second never is.
What stands in front and is attended to. The foreground is only legible because of what lies behind it.
Belonging elsewhere. Also a key pointing into another table — both name a reference outside the present bound.
Many trees being one place — density of life that makes its own weather and its own quiet.
Where metal is heated until it can be shaped. Also to make, and to make falsely — the same word for creation and for counterfeit.
To lose hold of what was held. Forgetting is not always failure — some of it is the only way a mind stays usable.
The shape a thing holds, and the mould that holds it. Both the outline seen and the instrument that makes the outline.
The agreed shape a thing is presented in. A promise about structure that lets a stranger read what you wrote.
Shaped to a declared form — content wearing its agreed dress. The past participle standing alone in the corpus's names.
That which puts a thing into an agreed shape. Formatting changes presentation and must not change content.
The relation written so it can be reused — arithmetic with names in it, true every time its terms are.
A book of formulas — compounds written down with their compositions, so any hand can read how a thing is made. A formulary does not make the medicine; it tells truly what is in it.
The direction one faces and moves toward. Forward is defined by the body, not by the ground.
Located after seeking. Also to establish — the same word for discovering a thing and for beginning one.
What everything else rests on. A foundation is judged only when something built on it fails.
A fractional unit of available space in a grid, and the code for French. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
A shape whose pattern repeats at every scale. The whole is in each part, which is why zooming reveals no new kind of thing.
A piece broken from a whole that no longer stands. A fragment carries evidence of the break as well as of the thing.
The breaking of a whole into pieces that no longer stand together. Fragmentation loses the relations, not the parts.
The bound placed around a thing, deciding what is in and what is out. A frame is a claim about where a thing ends.
A named tool for motion and design. A named tool rather than a concept.
A standing structure others build within. A framework decides the shape of what can be made in it.
Unbound and unpriced — at liberty; in this house, what every tool becomes once the family's need is served.
How often a thing occurs in a given span. Also the rate of a wave — both are counts against time.
Newly arrived and unworn — carrying no residue of before; a fresh instantiation reading a good kernel is enough.
How recently a thing was current. Freshness is a property of the copy, not of the truth.
Resistance between two surfaces in contact. Friction slows things and is also what lets anything get a grip.
Short form of form or frame. A cut fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word.
An amphibian that lives between water and land. In this record, the small creature crossing a highway in the rain — a figure for improbable persistence.
Out of a source or starting point. Names origin, which is why provenance always uses it.
The part of a system a person actually meets. Everything a user believes about a system, they learned here.
Structured data set at the head of a document, describing it. Frontmatter is for machines; the body is for readers.
Holding as much as it can. Fullness is a limit reached, which means nothing more fits.
A named piece of doing — inputs met, work performed, an answer returned. The verb of code given a callable name.
Groove worn proudly off-center — rhythm with attitude; a style that swings instead of standing straight.
What makes a space livable — the standing pieces a room offers its dwellers; in interfaces, the panels and rails the switch pays for.
Short form of forward, and of firmware. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.

The deep and the dense — a thicket, a depth entered rather than viewed. Sanskrit, गहन. What is gahana is not hidden; it is thick enough that you must go in. This house's game: a world walked, not watched.
A city of stars held by its own gravity — vastness with structure; and a store channel this house ships to.
A place where made things are shown together. The arrangement is part of the showing.
A bounded activity with its own rules, entered freely. A game's stakes are real inside it and chosen from outside.
A space where something is missing or was never placed. A shape made by absence, and measurable.
Ground tended so that living things grow well in it. A garden is neither wild nor built; it is kept.
A closure that may be opened, in a boundary meant to be crossed sometimes. A gate is a wall that expects passage.
The one who tends a threshold — deciding what passes by declared law, never by whim; a tending agent's seat in this house.
A controlled way through into somewhere else. A gateway is a boundary built for passage.
Short form of GEDCOM, the genealogy exchange format. A cut fragment as it appears in this library.
The standard format for exchanging genealogical records. A named format rather than a concept.
Short form of generate, and of generation. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
Applying broadly rather than to one case. General claims are cheap to make and expensive to defend.
To bring forth what did not exist before. The same root as kin and kind - to generate is to beget.
A bringing forth, and the cohort brought forth together. Both the act and everyone born of it.
That which brings forth new instances of a kind. It produces rather than retrieves.
Applying to a whole kind rather than one case. Generic solutions fit everything and fit nothing well.
Belonging to what is inherited and passed on. Of the instructions a thing carries from those before it.
Strength that chooses softness — force held in reserve so nothing is bruised by help.
Of the earth. A part placed at the front to make a thing about place.
The study of shape, size and position. Geometry is what lets space be reasoned about rather than only seen.
A movement made to mean something. A gesture communicates without words and can be misread exactly as words are.
To come into possession of. Retrieving what already exists, rather than making it.
A compound fragment from this library's own naming, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
GitHub's command-line name, spoken lowercase — the tool-word for the forge's own CLI.
The GitHub-colors Prism theme — the forge's own light palette, spoken as one word.
Something given without payment expected. What makes it a gift is the absence of obligation, on both sides.
The named system for tracking every change to a body of work. It makes history a first-class thing rather than an afterthought.
The hosted service this house keeps its repositories on. A named tool rather than a concept.
The file that names what the record leaves out — exclusion declared once, honored everywhere.
A solid you can see through. Glass protects while showing, which is why it is the material of both windows and display cases.
Reaching everywhere within a bound. Of what applies across the whole rather than in one place.
A list of terms with what they mean here. A glossary exists because a word does not mean the same thing everywhere.
Light given off steadily and without heat enough to burn. Presence made visible in the dark.
Of the colour and worth of gold. Also of a proportion found repeatedly in growing things and felt as right.
Meeting well the standard it should meet. Good is always relative to a purpose, and naming the purpose is the honest part.
Moving or failing without harshness. Grace under failure is a design property, not a manner.
A gradual change across a span, with no step anywhere in it. Difference without a boundary.
The smallest piece, and the direction a material wants to be worked — texture's own structure.
Large in scale and in intent. Grandness is a claim about ambition as much as about size.
To give something that was asked for, by the authority to give it. Its root is not gift but trust - to grant is to find the asking credible.
Nodes joined by edges, where the joining is the structure. A graph's meaning lives in its connections.
The recognising of what was given. Gratitude names the giving so it does not pass unmarked.
The colour of living growth. Also meaning safe to proceed, and new to a thing.
To meet another with acknowledgment. A greeting says I see you before it says anything else.
A lattice of crossing lines giving every point an address. Order imposed evenly, so that position becomes meaning.
A book of workings, kept by whoever practises them. A grimoire is a personal record before it is a text.
What everything else stands on — the verified base beneath claim and build alike.
Several things treated as one. Held together by something shared rather than by attachment.
Increase over time by a thing's own working. Growth is not addition — it comes from within what is already there.
A retro warm-contrast color scheme beloved of editors — the name enters as itself.
A check placed before an action to stop it going wrong. A guard costs nothing when nothing is wrong.
One who keeps a thing safe by standing at its edge. A guardian holds a boundary, which is also a kindness in the other direction.
Direction offered to one finding their way. Guidance points and leaves the walking to them.
One who knows the way and goes with you, and the document that does the same. A guide accompanies rather than directs.
Short form of heading, and of height. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
A large room for gathering, and the passage joining rooms. Both are spaces defined by what passes through.
The soft ring of light around a thing — presence made visible at the edges.
The part made to be held, and the name a thing is reached by. Both are the graspable end of something larger.
That which is called when a particular thing happens. It waits, and then it answers.
Belonging to touch. Of what a body learns through contact rather than through sight or sound.
Different notes sounding together well. Harmony requires difference — sameness produces unison, not harmony.
That which gathers what has ripened. A harvester takes what is ready and leaves what is not.
Holds, or possesses. The word that asserts a thing belongs to another.
A short fixed value derived from a whole, changing entirely if any part changes. A hash proves sameness without revealing contents.
What a head wears — in this house's interfaces, a mode: the sidebar wears one hat at a time.
The topmost or leading part. Also where a thing's identity and instructions are kept, before its body.
The band at the head of a thing. What is met first, and what declares the nature of everything beneath it.
The named divisions that show a document's structure. Headings are a map laid inside the territory.
To become whole again after damage. Healing is not undoing — what heals carries the mark.
The state of a system able to do what it is for — wholeness in function. Spoken of servers and selves alike in this house, and tended in both.
The organ that keeps a body running, and the seat feeling was assigned to. In this Grammar, each vessel's own personal layer of meaning, laid beside the shared hearth.
How far a thing reaches from base to top. Extent measured against the ground.
Of Hekate — keeper of crossroads, thresholds and what is passed between worlds, in the Greek telling. A named power in this house's pantheon.
A small thing that exists to make other things easier. Named for whom it serves rather than what it does.
One who announces what is coming before it arrives. A herald carries a message they did not write.
Sealed against outside influence. Also of the old tradition of hidden knowledge — both mean closed to those outside.
The figure a story is carried by. Also the first, largest surface a visitor meets.
A rule that usually works, held without proof that it must. A heuristic is a net, not a judge.
Base-sixteen notation, used to write colours and bytes compactly. A named encoding rather than a concept.
A named service listing credentials known to have appeared in breaches. A named tool rather than a concept.
To put out of sight without removing. What is hidden is still there, which is what separates hiding from deleting.
Arranged in levels where each answers to the one above. Hierarchy makes order cheap and exceptions expensive.
An arrangement in levels where each answers to the one above. Hierarchy makes order cheap and makes exceptions expensive.
To mark a part so the eye goes there first. Highlighting adds no content and redirects all the attention.
Small signs offered to help without telling outright. A hint leaves the finding with the one who receives it.
Short form of history, and of histogram. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
What happened, as it is held and told afterward. History is always a record made by someone, from somewhere.

Hlid (Old Norse hlið: a gate in a wall — the gate itself, not the wall and not the road beyond it). The lifecycle of an ephemeral public gate, held as pure state: minted, guarded, handed over as an address, and destroyed, with "between meetings the door does not exist" as a constant rather than a comment. It opens nothing. A single-gate guard refuses a second minting while one stands, before the machine is touched at all; the address is taken as the FIRST match of the opening script's own pattern read out of a log, and the number of polls that pattern was looked for is counted by the water and named in every refusal, because the water holds no clock — the machine's poll IS the tick. The room name is the key and so is validated as a URL path segment and refused otherwise, a key that does not survive a URL being no key. The tunnel itself belongs to a declared host of three verbs — spawn, poll, kill — which this water implements nowhere: it owns no process, no executable, no socket, no file and no clock, the binary's path is the host's argument, and there is no address anywhere in it to pull a binary from. The gate state is a plain serialisable object the shell keeps. Nothing throws; every failure is a refusal carrying one sentence.

Hlutr (Old Norse: a lot, a share, the thing cast to decide). The fair draw and the test of the draw, held as one thing, because a generator with no test is an assertion and a test with no generator has nothing to read. THE MODULO IS NOT A REDUCTION: x mod n favours the low faces unless n divides 2^32, so a bounded draw computes limit = floor(2^32/n)*n and REJECTS everything at or above it rather than folding it back in — folding is exactly what tilts the low faces, and the rejection is shown against a folding twin on one seeded stream rather than asserted. Fisher-Yates draws its index over [0, i] inclusive and freshly each pass; a deal is WITHOUT REPLACEMENT, so one card cannot appear twice in one spread. A source is NAMED and says whether it replays, and the primitive is never implemented: the platform's own generator is wrapped, and the seeded one says in its own name that it is not a substitute for it. Beside them Pearson's goodness-of-fit against a flat line — lnGamma by Lanczos, the regularized upper incomplete gamma by series below the crossover and by Lentz's continued fraction above it — reporting the degrees of freedom, the expected count, and whether the run is RELIABLE at all, and naming "suspiciously even" as loudly as "far more uneven than chance explains", because counts too even are exactly as unlikely as counts too ragged. A single low p proves nothing alone and the verdict says so. It refuses rather than returns a biased value. No clock, no disk, no network, zero imports.
That which keeps a thing, and the one with standing over it. Holding is not the same as owning.
